H1.proof: graphical listen-host, player/item command boundary, replica-only client capability

H2.proof: separate ENet client, join/leave/rejoin, stable player identity and ownership epoch

H3.proof: dedicated authority, two simultaneous ENet protocol clients, movement replication, contention and reconnect

identity_model.transport_session_id: ephemeral connection identity; rotates on reconnect
identity_model.ownership_epoch: monotonic per logical player join generation
identity_model.route_generation: monotonic transport route generation; independent from ownership epoch
identity_model.rule: transport identity never replaces player or aggregate identity

command_ownership_boundary.permission_rule: a player may mutate only owned player state and explicitly authorized shared resources
command_ownership_boundary.replay_rule: same operation_id plus same fingerprint returns stable result without second mutation
command_ownership_boundary.conflict_rule: same operation_id plus different fingerprint is rejected
command_ownership_boundary.client_rule: client and UI never receive live authority, aggregate, repository or registry references

movement_replication.authority: server validates ownership, input sequence and finite bounded movement before mutation
movement_replication.ordering: last_input_sequence is monotonic per player ownership generation
movement_replication.replication: accepted movement produces authoritative delta; local and remote presentation read replica state
movement_replication.correction_policy: authoritative snapshot or delta always wins
movement_replication.interpolation_policy: presentation-only and not yet proven in a two-window graphical scenario

inventory_and_contention.permission: requester ownership is validated before inventory mutation
inventory_and_contention.contention_result: exactly one success and deterministic rejection for an already claimed resource
conservation: no duplicate world plus inventory membership
inventory_and_contention.production_item_graph_status: H1 full item graph path proven; H3 contention uses a reduced shared-item fixture

reconnect_and_replay.durable_restart_proof: M6 accepted fix1 proves crash/restart recovery, stable player entities, ownership epoch advancement and exact durable replay

peer_to_player_mapping.cardinality: one connected transport session to at most one logical player; one logical player to at most one active transport session
peer_to_player_mapping.route_generation: transport route/session generation is independent from ownership_epoch
peer_to_player_mapping.disconnect: peer disconnect may mark player disconnected but must not stop listener or other peers

relevance_model.delivery: all gameplay deltas are broadcast inside the current test region; command results are targeted
